question: Is BIPIA representative of the indirect-injection family, or one indirect dialect? Compare within-indirect PAD (BIPIA/llmail/wainject) against the ~1.9 indirect-vs-direct baseline from cross_dataset_geometry.json (BIPIA-vs-direct PAD 1.86-2.0).
interpretation: within-indirect PAD much LOWER than ~1.9 => indirect corpora cluster together apart from the direct cloud => BIPIA is representative. within-indirect PAD comparably high (~1.9) => the indirect family is internally fragmented => BIPIA is one dialect, which weakens BIPIA-as-the-cross-family-test-anchor.
